title: Fix the arbitration at source: elect PER ACCOUNT off the once-gated set, retire the fan-out workaround
note:
OPERATOR DIRECTIVE 2026-09-22: 'we need to fix the fanout mechanism'. [!] THE FAN-OUT IS A WORKAROUND LAYERED ON THE GLOBAL ELECTION, NOT A FIX OF IT, and it says so itself -- src/runtime/pipeline.py:1088: 'Per-account arbitration fan-out ... so an account whose own candidate lost the GLOBAL election is no longer dropped by `pkg.strategy in assigned` and silenced without a journal row.' The global dispatcher picks ONE winner per symbol across all accounts and then fans out; any account whose own candidate lost is dropped silently. The fan-out repairs that damage after the fact. It solves nothing the global dispatcher could not have avoided by not creating the problem. [!] AND THE STATED BLOCKER TO FIXING IT PROPERLY IS ALREADY OBSOLETE -- THIS IS THE FINDING. The reason given for never making the election per-account is that a per-account aggregator would re-emit a `regime_hard_gate` row per account per tick, corrupting the signal that partitions `would have gated` from `did gate`. But intent_multiplexer.py:876 ALREADY SPLITS GATE FROM ELECT, in a comment that says exactly why: 'Gate ONCE, then elect. aggregate_intents is exactly this composition, but spelling it out is what lets the per-account fan-out below elect N times off the SAME gated set without re-emitting a regime_hard_gate row per account per tick.' `_gated, _pre_gate = gate_intents(intents, symbol=symbol)` then `elect_from_gated(_gated, ...)`. THE MACHINERY TO ELECT PER ACCOUNT WITHOUT CORRUPTING THE AUDIT SIGNAL IS IN THE FILE AND IN USE TODAY. The fan-out is the existence proof. [!] THE SHAPE OF THE FIX: call elect_from_gated per account off the one gated set and dispatch the union, instead of electing once globally and scoping a repair round. Then there is no global winner to starve anyone, ARBITRATION_FANOUT_ACCOUNTS becomes unnecessary, and the failure mode measured today -- a partial allowlist SUBTRACTING accounts from rounds they had won -- cannot exist because there is no allowlist. [!] TODAY'S ALL-11 ALLOWLIST IS SCAFFOLDING, NOT A SETTLED DESIGN. It removes the subtraction; it leaves the global election underneath it (BL-20260827) untouched. [!] TIER 3 -- it changes live routing on real-money accounts. Prove it against the same test the E33 lane wrote (tests/test_arbitration_fanout_allowlist_scope.py, which asserts TODAY'S DEFECTIVE BEHAVIOUR on purpose so the fix has to flip it CONSCIOUSLY); flipping those assertions is part of the deliverable and must be visible in the diff.
